The problem

Your Google profile is often the first thing customers see.
Before your website. Before the first call.

Most owners are too busy doing the work to keep it up to date. That’s where good businesses quietly lose customers.

01 /

It looks quiet

Old photos, no recent posts and out-of-date hours make a busy business look abandoned.

02 /

Reviews stall

Happy customers rarely leave a review unless someone asks them. Your latest review may be months old.

03 /

Reviews go unanswered

Customers read your replies as much as the reviews. Silence, especially after a bad one, costs trust.

FAQ

Straight answers.

Is there a contract?

No. It’s month to month, including on the launch offer. Cancel with 30 days’ notice and we’ll hand everything back. Your profile always stays yours.

What happens after the first 6 months?

If you joined on the launch offer, your price is locked for your first 6 months. After that it moves to the standard price, £149 a month. We’ll remind you by email before it changes, and you can cancel anytime.

Who can get the launch offer?

Anyone who signs up by 31 January 2027. There’s no limit on places.

How often do you work on my profile?

Every week we add a new post or photo and answer any new questions. Every new review gets a reply within 48 hours. Once a month we check your hours, services and details, send a fresh round of review requests to recent customers, and send you the monthly report. Urgent changes, like holiday hours or a new phone number, are made straight away. Just email us.

What do you need from me?

Manager access to your Google Business Profile, a handful of photos each month (phone photos are fine), and contact details for recent customers who’ve agreed to hear from you, so we can send review requests. About 10 minutes a month.

How soon will I see results?

Most businesses see a more active profile and new reviews within the first month or two. Changes in calls and map views usually take longer and depend on your area, your competition and the reviews customers choose to leave. We can’t guarantee rankings or a number of reviews, and anyone who does should be treated with caution.

Do you write fake reviews?

No. Never. Every review comes from a real customer. Fake reviews break Google’s rules and consumer protection law in the UK and elsewhere.

Is this Google-policy compliant?

Yes. We ask every customer the same way. There’s no “review gating” (we don’t filter out unhappy customers before asking) and no incentives (no discounts or gifts in exchange for reviews). We reply to negative reviews professionally rather than hiding them.

Do you work outside the UK?

Yes. Everything is done remotely, so we work with local businesses in the UK, Ireland, the US, Canada, Australia and New Zealand.

Which businesses is this for?

Any business customers find locally: clinics, dentists, salons, cleaners, trades, vets, law firms, restaurants, gyms and more.
